name: Territory Rewards
summary: Territory rewards pay players for capturing and defending flags.
role: Stay inside objectives when it matters. The game pays capture credit to defenders present for the claim and gives periodic defense rewards while holding ground.
fun_facts: Defense rewards are timer-based, so holding a flag can matter even after the initial capture payout.

name: Kill and Assist Rewards
summary: Kill and assist rewards pay cash and XP for damaging and eliminating Furries.
role: Contribute damage even if you cannot secure every kill. Assists pay a smaller share and help support steady progression during wave pressure.
fun_facts: The rare kill reward roll is at ten percent.

name: Boss Rewards
summary: Boss rewards pay large cash and XP payouts for defeating the Traditional boss, with contribution-based sharing.
role: Damage the boss if you want reward credit. The top contributor receives the main payout roll, and other contributors receive a scaled share.

stats.defeated_badge: Awarded to all players on boss defeat

fun_facts: The boss defeat badge is awarded to all players when the boss dies.

name: Daily Rewards
summary: Daily rewards grant cash with streak scaling, with a larger Plus reward track available separately.
role: Claim daily rewards consistently to build cash outside direct combat payouts.
fun_facts: Daily reward streak math uses a multiplier, not a flat repeated bonus.

name: Activity Rewards
summary: Activity rewards grant XP for staying active long enough during the day.
role: Stay active for the full activity window to claim a once-per-day XP payout.
fun_facts: The activity reward timer is ten minutes, matching 600 seconds.

name: Group Rewards
summary: Group rewards grant bonus XP and the M60 reward weapon for members of the LQI Roblox group.
role: Join the group if you want the group reward track, including the M60 weapon reward.
fun_facts: M60 is the group reward weapon.

name: Referral Rewards
summary: Referral rewards pay both the inviting player and the invitee after the invite qualifies.
role: Use referrals as a progression boost when bringing a new player into the game.
fun_facts: The referral qualification delay is only ten seconds.
